comment: No source is published. The window length free-running is 128 samples at the counter-clockwise end, rising to a cap of the sample rate times 1.024, itself capped at 262144, so about one second; clocked it is chosen from the beat divided by 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 and 64, with any candidate under 128 samples or over the cap dropped. Clock division multiplies the beat by 2/3 for Triplet and 1.5 for Dotted. Shape sets the analysis hop to half the window times 2 to the power of minus twice the knob. The dry/wet mix is slewed towards its target at 50 per second and is forced to zero whenever the freeze is off, so an unfrozen FFTF is a straight wire. Nothing in the plugin reads a channel count, so every port is mono. The panel menu also carries Reload panel and Poll SVG for reload, which every module in this plugin has and which only reload the panel artwork; they are left out.
